section1Heading: A Shift Toward Long-Term Mobility Planning
section1Body: The final quarter of 2025 marked a period of consolidation and strategic evolution for the global investment migration industry, reinforcing a shift toward long-term, resilience-based mobility planning over short-term convenience.
section2Body: The Global Citizen Solutions Global Passport Index 2025 showed European passports continuing to strengthen, occupying nine of the top ten positions — reflecting a growing emphasis on quality-of-life indicators and investment potential.
section3Body: Portugal's nationality law reforms, enhanced Caribbean due-diligence standards, and St. Vincent and the Grenadines' forthcoming Citizenship program all point to a more robust, transparent, and credible industry.
pullQuote: Collectively, these trends position investment migration as a more regulated, resilient, and strategically relevant pillar of global mobility in the years ahead.
pullQuoteAuthor: Patricia Casaburi, CEO of Global Citizen Solutions
